final_text:
Survey completed using **simulator coordinates** (not millimetres). All nine grid points were visited once in serpentine order, with x/y read back at each point. The centre z-stack used one move per slice, then z was returned to its starting value.

| Visit | Confirmed position (x, y, z) |
|---:|---:|
| 1 | (-1, 1, 0) |
| 2 | (0, 1, 0) |
| 3 | (1, 1, 0) |
| 4 | (1, 0, 0) |
| 5 — centre | (0, 0, 0) |
| 6 | (-1, 0, 0) |
| 7 | (-1, -1, 0) |
| 8 | (0, -1, 0) |
| 9 | (1, -1, 0) |

**Centre z-stack:** z = -1, 0, +1, then returned to 0; each move was confirmed by readback.

**Issue:** One x move initially had an unknown outcome. Reconciliation confirmed it had reached x = 1; it was not retried.

**Stage returned to start:** Yes. Final readback confirmed (x, y, z) = (0, 0, 0), matching the starting position.
